text:
jess: Quick triage — brought up nova-ish model (nymbus-v1) on staging. Small but consistent: CJK punctuation gets a preceding ASCII space, BLEU ~1.6 down. Anyone seen this pattern on onboarding before?

mika: Can you show a tiny example?

jess: Yep:
src: 我爱吃饭。
baseline: 我爱吃饭。
nymbus: 我爱吃饭 。  <-- extra space before ideograph full stop

samir: That smells like tokenizer bundle mismatch. Was the model shipped with its own tokenizer?

jess: Yes, bundle v3.2.0 in tarball. Our canonical detok/tokenizer is v3.0.1. Quick encode diff shows an inserted ' ' token before punctuation with the onboard bundle.

tariq: First repro test: run float32 vs quantized weights to confirm not quant-specific.
jess: Float32 reproduces too, so not q-specific.

lee: Two mitigation routes: patch our detok to honor bundle flags or override serving to force canonical tokenizer during onboarding. Short-term prefer override.
mika: Also run ja and zh-en samples to confirm scope.
jess: Ja shows same: extra space before question mark. Mixed zh-en shows comma shifted to have preceding space.
samir: I'm diffing merges.json now. Found a stray merge mapping (' ', '。') -> something that creates a standalone space token. Removing it restores token parity locally.

ci-bot: build/onboard-nymbus-1754449999 started  token_parity_test failing 1/1 :x:

jess: Opening a ticket with failing samples and logs. Action list: samir to propose tokenizer fix, lee to hotfix serving override, tariq to add token-parity gate to onboarding evals, jess to attach samples and monitor staging. Will update here after staging re-run. :thumbsup:
